WITH driver_qualify_counts AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as qualify_count
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY driverId
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers) as avg_qualify
)
SELECT 
  dqc.driverId,
  dqc.qualify_count,
  CAST(dqc.qualify_count AS FLOAT) / s.avg_qualify as ratio
FROM driver_qualify_counts dqc
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
